theme.en: Capital and Capacity Reshape the AI Stack

dek.en: A $1 billion U.S. quantum-wafer award and $1.025 billion across two AI-hardware financings push money toward domestic fabrication, memory-centric inference, and co-packaged optics. Full ASML order books and a reported 10% AMD price increase show how constrained capacity is already flowing through to customers.
dek.zh: 美国向量子晶圆制造投入$10亿，两笔AI硬件融资合计$10.25亿，资本正涌向本土制造、存储优先推理和共封装光学。ASML订单排满至2027年，加之AMD据报涨价约10%，显示受限产能的成本已开始向客户传导。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: FIT Diversifies AI Optics With Corning EBO and TSMC Talks
title.zh: FIT借Corning EBO与台积电洽谈分散AI光学布局

summary.en: FIT is pursuing Corning EBO technology while discussing co-packaging with TSMC, giving the company two routes into AI optical interconnects. The parallel tracks matter because accelerator clusters increasingly need optical links closer to the package, but neither discussion yet establishes production volume or timing.
summary.zh: FIT一面推进Corning EBO技术，一面与台积电讨论共封装，为切入AI光互连布局两条路线。随着加速器集群需要把光链路进一步靠近封装端，这种双线布局更具意义，但现阶段尚未披露量产规模或时间表。

title.en: AMD Reportedly Plans a 10% Q4 Chip Price Increase
title.zh: AMD据报计划第四季度将芯片价格上调约10%

summary.en: AMD reportedly plans to raise chip prices by about 10% starting in the fourth quarter as higher TSMC costs pressure GPUs and motherboard components. If implemented broadly, the increase would be a direct pass-through of leading-edge manufacturing costs into the PC and accelerator supply chain.
summary.zh: 据报道，受台积电成本上升挤压GPU和主板相关芯片利润影响，AMD计划从第四季度起将芯片价格上调约10%。若大范围执行，这将是先进制程制造成本直接向PC与加速器供应链传导的明确信号。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: Chinese GAA Device Targets 3nm-Like Performance With DUV
title.zh: 中国GAA器件以DUV瞄准3nm级性能

summary.en: The Chinese Academy of Sciences has reported GAA transistors with on-off ratios above 500,000 and device-level performance described as comparable to 3nm-class technology using DUV lithography. Middle-end-of-line constraints still limit the practical path to roughly 5nm-equivalent integration, so the result is a device advance rather than proof of a production-ready 3nm process.
summary.zh: 中国科学院据报开发出开关比超过500,000的全环绕栅极（GAA）晶体管，并以DUV光刻实现被描述为接近3nm级的器件性能。中段制程（MEOL）约束仍将实际集成路径限制在约5nm等效水平，因此这更接近器件层面的进展，而非可量产3nm制程的证明。

title.en: Nexperia Partners With Tata After Chinese-Parent Fallout
title.zh: 与中国母公司关系生变后，Nexperia转与Tata合作

summary.en: Nexperia has formed a semiconductor manufacturing and technology partnership with Tata Electronics after its fallout with its Chinese parent. The agreement gives Nexperia another route into India's expanding chip-manufacturing base and signals a broader effort to diversify production relationships amid ownership and geopolitical friction.
summary.zh: 在与中国母公司关系生变后，Nexperia与Tata Electronics建立半导体制造与技术合作。该协议为Nexperia接入印度扩张中的芯片制造体系提供了新路径，也反映出企业在所有权与地缘政治摩擦下分散生产合作关系的趋势。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: Samsung Claims a Tenfold AI Speed Gain From Stacked zHBM
title.zh: 三星称堆叠zHBM可令AI速度提升10倍

summary.en: Samsung says its stacked zHBM memory can improve AI accelerator performance by as much as tenfold. The claim points to memory architecture, not compute alone, as a route around the bandwidth wall; production readiness, workload coverage, and system-level power data remain the tests that will determine its practical value.
summary.zh: 三星称其堆叠式zHBM存储可将AI加速器性能最高提升10倍。这一说法把突破带宽墙的重点从单纯增加算力转向存储架构，但其实际价值仍取决于量产成熟度、适用工作负载范围和系统级功耗数据。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: ASML's Order Book Is Reportedly Full Through 2027
title.zh: ASML订单据报已排满至2027年

summary.en: ASML's order book is reportedly filled through 2027 as advanced-node and AI-related fab spending sustains lithography demand. The long backlog improves revenue visibility for ASML but also leaves leading-edge capacity additions exposed to tool-delivery timing.
summary.zh: 据报道，先进制程与AI相关晶圆厂投资持续支撑光刻需求，ASML订单已排满至2027年。长订单周期提高了ASML收入的可见度，同时也意味着领先制程扩产将更受设备交付节奏制约。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: U.S. Awards Anderon $1 Billion for Quantum Wafer Manufacturing
title.zh: 美国向Anderon量子晶圆制造项目拨款$10亿

summary.en: The U.S. has awarded $1 billion to IBM's Anderon effort to manufacture quantum wafers domestically. The award moves industrial policy beyond conventional logic and memory fabs, putting public money behind the manufacturing infrastructure needed to scale quantum hardware from laboratory systems.
summary.zh: 美国向IBM旗下Anderon项目拨款$10亿，用于在本土制造量子晶圆。这笔资金将产业政策从传统逻辑与存储晶圆厂延伸至量子硬件制造基础设施，目标是推动量子系统走出实验室并扩大规模。

title.en: Challengers & New Silicon
title.zh: 新势力与新硅

title.en: Lambda and Groq Alumni Raise $875 Million for Memory-First Inference Chips
title.zh: Lambda与Groq前员工为存储优先推理芯片融资$8.75亿

summary.en: Former Lambda and Groq employees have secured $875 million to build memory-first AI inference chips. The unusually large financing reflects investor conviction that inference bottlenecks are shifting toward memory movement, though the team still must translate its architecture into competitive silicon and deployed systems.
summary.zh: Lambda与Groq前员工获得$8.75亿融资，用于开发“存储优先”的AI推理芯片。如此大规模的融资反映出投资者认为推理瓶颈正转向数据搬运，但团队仍需把架构设想转化为有竞争力的芯片和实际部署。

title.en: Ayar Labs Secures $150 Million for Co-Packaged Optics
title.zh: Ayar Labs为共封装光学获得$1.5亿融资

summary.en: Ayar Labs has raised $150 million to advance co-packaged optics for high-bandwidth computing systems. The round directs more capital at the electrical-I/O power and reach limits surrounding AI accelerators, while commercial volume and customer deployment remain the key milestones.
summary.zh: Ayar Labs获得$1.5亿融资，用于推进面向高带宽计算系统的共封装光学。此轮融资进一步瞄准AI加速器周边电互连在功耗与传输距离上的限制，下一步关键仍是商业化出货规模和客户部署。

theme.en: Inference Systems Squeeze Memory and Communication
theme.zh: 推理系统压缩存储与通信开销

dek.en: This week's strongest systems papers attack data movement at several layers: sharded training traffic, edge coordination, speculative decoding, and KV-cache footprint. Quantum work remains simulation-heavy, offering useful formulations but not yet hardware evidence.
dek.zh: 本周较强的系统论文从多个层面削减数据搬运：分片训练通信、边缘协同、推测解码与KV-cache占用。量子方向仍以模拟验证为主，给出了有价值的方法框架，但尚缺乏硬件实证。

title.en: Accelerators & Distributed Compute
title.zh: 加速器与分布式计算

title.en: Federated Aggregation Reduces Traffic in Sharded Training
title.zh: 联邦聚合降低分片训练通信量

summary.en: FL+FSDP and FL+HSDP divide large sharded-training jobs into loosely coupled federation groups, using FedAvg-style aggregation to reduce inter-group traffic while bounding global batch size. The authors evaluate Llama 3.1 8B pretraining on 512 A100 GPUs under identical hyperparameters and report better scaling than conventional sharded data parallelism. The result directly addresses heterogeneous multi-tier interconnects, but broader convergence behavior and production fault tolerance still need validation.
summary.zh: FL+FSDP与FL+HSDP把大规模分片训练拆成松耦合的联邦组，以类似FedAvg的聚合减少组间流量，同时限制全局批量大小。作者在512张A100 GPU上以相同超参数进行Llama 3.1 8B预训练，并报告了优于传统分片数据并行的扩展表现。该方法直指异构多层互连瓶颈，但更广泛的收敛特性与生产环境容错仍需验证。

title.en: Distributed Edge Inference Speeds Multiview Detection
title.zh: 分布式边缘推理加速多视角检测

papers.authors: Gianluca Mittone, Giulio Malenza, Marco Aldinucci, et al.

summary.en: A FastFL C/C++ implementation distributes multiview detection across edge devices and reports up to 1.92x lower inference time than a centralized solution using the same devices. Experiments span different compute capabilities and network bandwidths, making the work relevant to accelerator placement across the cloud-edge continuum. The maximum gain is topology-dependent, so the full range of results matters more than the headline speedup.
summary.zh: 该工作以FastFL C/C++框架把多视角检测分布到边缘设备上，在使用相同设备时报告了相对集中式方案最高1.92倍的推理加速。实验覆盖不同算力与网络带宽，对云边连续体中的加速器部署具有参考意义。最高增益依赖具体拓扑，因此完整结果分布比单一峰值更值得关注。

title.en: Hardware-Relevant AI Research
title.zh: 硬件相关AI研究

title.en: SwitchSD Detects When Speculative Decoding Should Copy
title.zh: SwitchSD判断推测解码何时应复制上下文

papers.authors: Roy Eisenstadt, Ido Cohen, Edo Cohen-Karlik, et al.

summary.en: SwitchSD trains lightweight probes on a target model's internal representations to distinguish genuine copy intent from accidental n-gram repetition. The probes exceed 0.99 AUC and let the runtime switch between neural drafting and context copying, producing throughput gains of up to 15% across Llama and Qwen families. The evidence is promising for inference serving, though the preprint's gains may vary with prompt mix and serving-stack overhead.
summary.zh: SwitchSD在目标模型内部表征上训练轻量探针，用于区分真实复制意图与偶然的n-gram重复。探针AUC超过0.99，使运行时可在神经草稿与上下文复制之间切换，并在Llama和Qwen系列上实现最高15%的吞吐提升。该结果对推理服务颇具吸引力，但作为预印本，其收益可能随提示词分布和服务栈开销而变化。

title.en: Astronex-World Streams a 5B World Model on One L20
title.zh: Astronex-World在单张L20上实时运行5B世界模型

summary.en: Astronex-World 1.0 combines block-causal attention, cross-block KV caching, and few-step distillation to generate controllable 832x480 video at 24 fps. Its 5B causal model streams in real time on one NVIDIA L20 48 GB GPU, while all five training stages reportedly fit on two L20s; scores reach 73.5 on WBench Navi and 70.0 on WBench Full. The compact deployment profile is the main systems result, but benchmark quality and interactive stability need independent replication.
summary.zh: Astronex-World 1.0结合分块因果注意力、跨块KV缓存和少步蒸馏，以24 fps生成可控的832x480视频。其5B因果模型可在单张NVIDIA L20 48 GB GPU上实时运行，五个训练阶段据报仅需两张L20；WBench Navi与Full得分分别为73.5和70.0。紧凑部署是其主要系统贡献，但画质基准与交互稳定性仍需独立复现。

title.en: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Cuts Global KV Cache to 890 Bytes per Token
title.zh: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash将全局KV缓存压至每token 890字节

summary.en: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash combines cross-layer KV reuse with FP4 caching to reduce its always-resident global KV cache to 890 bytes per token, about one-quarter of DeepSeek-V4-Flash. The 552B-parameter multimodal MoE supports one-million-token contexts while activating 16B parameters per decode token and 8B during prefill. Those numbers directly target HBM and SSD pressure in long-horizon agents, but they are vendor-reported preprint results that still need independent quality and deployment testing.
summary.zh: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash结合跨层KV复用与FP4缓存，把常驻HBM的全局KV缓存压缩到每token 890字节，约为DeepSeek-V4-Flash的四分之一。该552B参数多模态MoE支持100万token上下文，解码时每token激活16B参数，预填充阶段激活8B参数。这些指标直接针对长时程智能体的HBM与SSD压力，但目前仍是厂商预印本结果，需要独立的质量与部署验证。

title.en: Quantum Computing
title.zh: 量子计算

title.en: A State-Space Construction for Quantum FIR Filters
title.zh: 量子FIR滤波器的状态空间构造

papers.authors: Roope Salmi, Davide Rocchesso, Vesa Välimäki

summary.en: This paper maps finite impulse response filtering into unitary quantum circuits through a state-space formulation and introduces a quantum delay gate analogous to a classical delay line. Projection emulation extends the construction beyond lossless systems to low-pass and other bounded filters, and the blocks can compose inside larger quantum algorithms. All demonstrations use a circuit simulator, so any practical speedup depends on future fault-tolerant hardware and amplitude-estimation costs.
summary.zh: 该论文通过状态空间表述把有限脉冲响应（FIR）滤波映射为酉量子电路，并提出与经典延迟线对应的量子延迟门。通过模拟投影算子，方案从无损系统扩展到低通等有界滤波器，并可作为模块嵌入更大的量子算法。所有演示均基于电路模拟器，实际加速仍取决于未来容错量子硬件和幅度估计的成本。

title.en: Quantum Graph Convolutions Trade Parameters for Circuit Structure
title.zh: 量子图卷积以电路结构换取更少参数

papers.authors: Paul San Sebastian Sein, Theodor Iosif, Tilen G. Limbäck-Stokin, et al.

summary.en: The study implements quantum versions of Simplified Graph Convolution and Linear Graph Convolution and compares their accuracy and optimization behavior with classical baselines. In simulation, the quantum models remain competitive with fewer parameters, while gradient-cost and classical-simulability analyses identify where training is feasible. No quantum hardware results are reported, so the work clarifies algorithmic regimes rather than demonstrating an end-to-end advantage.
summary.zh: 该研究实现了简化图卷积（SGC）与线性图卷积（LGC）的量子版本，并与经典基线比较精度和优化行为。在模拟中，量子模型以更少参数保持竞争力，梯度成本与经典可模拟性分析则界定了可训练区间。论文未报告量子硬件结果，因此其贡献在于澄清算法适用区间，而非证明端到端优势。
